message.content: {"note_claim": "Nagoya's central grid blocks were planned by Tokugawa Ieyasu-era builders at Nagoya Castle's construction (around 1610), predating Sapporo's grid, so postwar Nagoya did not copy Sapporo.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "名古屋台地の北端に名古屋城が築かれ、その南側を京にならって碁盤の目に区画して町人の住居とし、碁盤割と呼んだ。", "reason": "The page states the Nagoya grid (碁盤割) was laid out south of Nagoya Castle in the early Edo period, substantiating that it predates Sapporo's grid, though it doesn't give the 1610 date or mention Sapporo."}

parsed.note_claim: Nagoya's central grid blocks were planned by Tokugawa Ieyasu-era builders at Nagoya Castle's construction (around 1610), predating Sapporo's grid, so postwar Nagoya did not copy Sapporo.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 名古屋台地の北端に名古屋城が築かれ、その南側を京にならって碁盤の目に区画して町人の住居とし、碁盤割と呼んだ。
parsed.reason: The page states the Nagoya grid (碁盤割) was laid out south of Nagoya Castle in the early Edo period, substantiating that it predates Sapporo's grid, though it doesn't give the 1610 date or mention Sapporo.
